name: 主键设计(自增 vs UUID)诊断
description: InnoDB 使用聚簇索引（Clustered Index），数据按主键顺序物理存储。主键设计直接影响写入性能、存储效率和查询模式。自增 INT/BIGINT 主键写入顺序追加，效率最高但在分布式场景有问题。UUID 主键随机写入导致大量 B+Tree 页分裂，写入性能可能下降 3-5 倍。UUID v7 和 Snowflake ID 是兼顾唯一性和有序性的折中方案。

signals.desc: 页创建速率异常高（页分裂的间接信号）

conditions.desc: 表使用 UUID/GUID 作为主键
INSERT 性能随数据量增长明显下降

skip_when.desc: 表数据量 < 100 万行，主键类型对性能影响可忽略
已使用有序 UUID（UUID v7 / ordered UUID），无随机写入问题

root_causes.name: UUID 主键导致随机页分裂
root_causes.desc: 标准 UUID (v1/v4) 是随机的，INSERT 时目标叶子页随机分散在整个 B+Tree 中。当目标页已满时触发页分裂：InnoDB 分配新页并移动约一半数据到新页。大量随机页分裂导致：1) 额外 IO 写入；2) 页填充率约 50-70%（vs 自增的接近 100%）；3) 碎片严重。

root_causes.name: 自增主键在分布式环境的问题
root_causes.desc: auto_increment 是实例级别的，多个 MySQL 实例无法生成全局唯一 ID。分库分表场景中需要额外的 ID 生成器。auto_increment_increment 和 auto_increment_offset 可以做简单的分布式自增，但不灵活。

root_causes.name: 主键过长浪费二级索引空间
root_causes.desc: InnoDB 二级索引的叶子节点存储主键值。UUID 占 36 字节（字符串存储）或 16 字节（BINARY(16)），而 BIGINT 只占 8 字节。每个二级索引的每条记录都多存 8-28 字节，多个二级索引叠加后空间浪费显著。

root_causes.name: 页合并（Page Merge）效率低
root_causes.desc: 当页中数据因 DELETE 减少到 MERGE_THRESHOLD（默认 50%）以下时，InnoDB 尝试与相邻页合并。UUID 主键的数据分布随机，相邻页的逻辑关联弱，合并困难。导致碎片长期无法自动回收。

step1_check_pk_type.sql: SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE, c.COLUMN_TYPE, c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = k.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = k.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = k.COLUMN_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' AND c.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME

step2_page_split_estimate.desc: 通过碎片和 pages_created 估算页分裂频率
step2_page_split_estimate.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_pages_created', 'Innodb_pages_written', 'Innodb_pages_read')

step3_uuid_table_fragmentation.desc: 找出使用 UUID 主键且碎片严重的表
step3_uuid_table_fragmentation.sql: SELECT t.TABLE_SCHEMA, t.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_TYPE AS pk_type, t.TABLE_ROWS, ROUND(t.DATA_LENGTH/1024/1024, 1) AS data_mb, ROUND(t.DATA_FREE/1024/1024, 1) AS free_mb, ROUND(t.DATA_FREE / GREATEST(t.DATA_LENGTH, 1) * 100, 1) AS frag_pct FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON t.TABLE_SCHEMA = k.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_NAME = k.TABLE_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c ON k.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND k.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' AND (c.DATA_TYPE IN ('char', 'varchar', 'binary', 'varbinary') AND c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH >= 16) AND t.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY t.DATA_FREE DESC

step4_secondary_index_overhead.desc: 计算因主键过长导致的二级索引额外开销
step4_secondary_index_overhead.sql: SELECT t.TABLE_SCHEMA, t.TABLE_NAME, ROUND(t.INDEX_LENGTH/1024/1024, 1) AS total_idx_mb, COUNT(DISTINCT s.INDEX_NAME) - 1 AS secondary_idx_count, c.COLUMN_TYPE AS pk_type FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS s ON t.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_NAME = s.TABLE_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON t.TABLE_SCHEMA = k.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_NAME = k.TABLE_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c ON k.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND k.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' AND t.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') GROUP BY t.TABLE_SCHEMA, t.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_TYPE HAVING secondary_idx_count > 2 ORDER BY t.INDEX_LENGTH DESC LIMIT 20

step2_page_split_stats.sql: SELECT ROUND((1 - DATA_FREE / GREATEST(DATA_LENGTH, 1)) * 100, 1) AS page_utilization FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{schema}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{table}' AND ENGINE = 'InnoDB'

step3_pk_type_detail.desc: 检查主键列的详细类型
step3_pk_type_detail.sql: SELECT c.COLUMN_TYPE, CASE WHEN c.COLUMN_TYPE LIKE '%char(36)%' THEN 'v4' WHEN c.COLUMN_TYPE LIKE '%binary(16)%' THEN 'binary' ELSE 'other' END AS pk_format FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = k.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = k.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = k.COLUMN_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' AND c.TABLE_SCHEMA = '{schema}' AND c.TABLE_NAME = '{table}'

step1_pk_analysis.sql: SELECT c.DATA_TYPE, c.COLUMN_TYPE, CASE WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('char','varchar','binary','varbinary') AND c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH >= 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS random_pk, t.TABLE_ROWS FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = k.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = k.TABLE_NAME AND c.COLUMN_NAME = k.COLUMN_NAME JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = t.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME = t.TABLE_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY' AND c.TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys') AND t.TABLE_ROWS > 100000 ORDER BY t.TABLE_ROWS DESC LIMIT 10

version_specific_notes.5.7: 无 UUID_TO_BIN 函数，需应用层做 UUID 转换。自增使用传统锁模式（innodb_autoinc_lock_mode=1）
version_specific_notes.8.0: 新增 UUID_TO_BIN / BIN_TO_UUID 函数。UUID_TO_BIN(uuid, 1) 支持 swap 使 UUID v1 有序。innodb_autoinc_lock_mode 默认 2（交错模式），配合 binlog_format=ROW 适合高并发 INSERT
version_specific_notes.8.4: 对有序 UUID 的优化改进。考虑原生支持 UUID v7 的讨论

real_world_examples.scenario: SaaS 平台从 UUID CHAR(36) 迁移到 BIGINT 自增，INSERT TPS 提升 4 倍
real_world_examples.symptoms: 核心表 1 亿行，INSERT 从 8000 TPS 降至 2000 TPS。碎片率 65%
real_world_examples.root_cause: UUID CHAR(36) 主键导致随机页分裂和严重碎片
real_world_examples.resolution: 新增 BIGINT 自增主键，UUID 降级为唯一索引。分批迁移数据
real_world_examples.result: INSERT 恢复到 8000 TPS，碎片率从 65% 降至 5%，总存储减少 40%
